newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Taiping leaps on property sale rumours.
newsitem.headline: Taiping leaps on property sale rumours.

text.p: Shares of Malaysian retail property developer Taiping Consolidated Bhd hit a new high for 1997 on Monday, spurred on by rumours it may be looking to sell one of its most prized projects.
Around 0815 GMT, the stock was up 75 cents or 34.4 percent to 2.93 ringgit on heavy volume of 22.9 million.
The company's 1997 transferable subscription rights jumped 33 cents or 68.04 percent to 81.5 cents on a volume of 5.6 million.
Dealers said there was speculation that Taiping may be looking to sell its entire interest in the Sentul Raya mixed property development project in central Kuala Lumpur.
The development consists of condominiums and shopping malls.
Taiping currently earns the bulk of its income from rentals of its up-market shopping complexes in central Kuala Lumpur.
